input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Down Home"?

documents.text: Down Home (John Coltrane album) Down Home is an album by saxophonist John Coltrane which was recorded in 1997 and released on Schott Music's Intuition label. In his review for Allmusic, Scott Yanow calls it "Not quite a classic but certainly worthwhile". On AllAboutJazz Douglas Payne said "Down Home, despite its brief 45-minute running time is, indeed, mighty fine; a hearty menu with plenty of meaty playing".
